finding: G10 retains complete phase0 d9, but existing uniform-d9 overlays later-phase d9 re-emissions. Same scheme name therefore changes observation semantics relative to the phase0-only20M source. Existing d9 rank sidecars instead read phase0, requiring explicit reconciliation.

input.why_zero_history: row schema 1: a row is a bare FEN, chess.Board(fen) has an empty move stack, and the encoder fills history slot 0 only -- slots 1..7 (planes 13..103) and every repetition plane stay ZERO. Row schema 2 banks history_root_fen + history_uci and board_from_row replays them, so the 8 frames are the frames live play encodes; see row_schema_counts and history_slots_filled_histogram for which this run derived

value_channels.categorical_target: ABSENT — outcome-derived, and wdl_target carries the outcome
value_channels.moves_left: ABSENT — a corpus row does not know its game's length
value_channels.search_wdl: cp_to_wdl_array of the SCHEME's best-move value: Stockfish's searched root value, side-to-move POV. ⚑ NOT our MCTS's value, which is what this column means on production shards
value_channels.sf_wdl: ABSENT — deliberately. lc0_control_train.py's launch guard 1 (assert_pid_cannot_reassert_sf_wdl) refuses any config with sf_wdl_frac > 0 regardless of what the shards carry, so a value written here could never reach a loss on this rig
value_channels.wdl_target: the corpus row's exact game result, already stored from that row's own side-to-move seat (result_from_pov). 0=W/1=D/2=L

required_training_overrides.search_wdl_frac: the whole non-outcome share. These shards carry no sf_wdl, so losses.py would redirect any SF share onto the raw game outcome; the searched value is in search_wdl

path_resolution: run03_s3 has summary.json, not manifest.json. Companion path is run07_g10_companion4, not run07_g10.

published_row_examined.limitation: One published row establishes existence/retained field semantics, not prevalence or strength. No second row or full payload analyzed.

code_paths.fact: PhaseResult.as_row retains every phase/depth block; later refinements do not overwrite phase0.
G10 extends top4 to d12 only if complete d10 top2 margin <=10cp; stopped rows have no d12 block.
Phase0 unrestricted full width; later phases restrict searchmoves and append separate results.
Game move selection reads results[0] full-width scores, not the narrowed phase best.
TT carried across phases and positions within each game, cleared per game. Subsequent phase0 search can inherit deeper earlier-position work.
full_width_block reads phase0. value_at traverses phases backwards, taking latest available phase for move/requested depth.
nodes uses phase0; uniform/topK starts with phase0 support but overlays values via value_at. TopK deepens an offline-ranked subset or raises EnvelopeMiss.
Parser has uniform-dD, topK-dD2-rest-dD1, nodes-N; no explicit fixed-depth phase0-only selector.
Uniform policy/value depth cannot exceed full-width9 envelope; narrowed d10/d12 is not all-legal deeper supervision.
Matching policy/value uniform depth reuses MoveValues. --value-depth9 does not force phase0.
Policy is softmax of scheme q values with selected temperature/floor.
Default root value uses best effective cp from the same scheme values; observation selection affects value too.
d9_lines explicitly selects phases[0] complete depth9; near-close rankings use phase0.
Shown source contract checks scheme/depth/temp/floor/cp-map/encoding/storage but not observation-phase convention.

recipe_transfer.reusable: All-legal phase0 d9 and complete history survive. Global BT4, exact-tie and near-close formulas are reusable after choosing/stamping the SF observation convention and rebinding all sidecars to new source identities.
recipe_transfer.not_same_labels: Existing uniform-d9 on G10 can change SF scores, maxima, exact ties, near-close membership and root WDL. Existing20M sidecars/checkpoints are not interchangeable with different rows.
recipe_transfer.remaining_distribution_shift: Even explicit phase0-d9 has different games/seeds/worker allocation and richer across-position TT history. Same engine/book/temp/cp map does not reconstruct a bare all:9 generator counterfactual.
recipe_transfer.adaptive_refinement: No generic latest-available-per-move scheme exists in examined parser. Top4-d12 may fail where G10 stopped or offline latest-d9 ranking selects outside generator shortlist. No silent depth fallback is justified.

minimal_fix_options.proposal: On an inactive main-based checkout add a named selector such as legacy latest-phase-at-depth versus phase0-at-depth. Preserve existing default/legacy semantics and every current artifact. Stamp policy/value observation selection in derived shard/summary provenance, and require matching rank/quality sidecar and mixer contracts. --value-depth alone is not an observation selector.

Once explicit selection exists, deliberately choose complete phase0 d9 for future G10 policy, default root value, exact-tie sets, near-close ranks and finite-tail quality. This preserves20M observation type, not identical rows/search state. Keep old default unchanged; make future choice explicit.

smallest_later_comparison.cpu_banked: Preregister one source-qualified game-clustered G10 sample. Pair phase0-d9 versus legacy latest-phase-d9 on identical rows, mapping/temp/floor and BT4 data. Record cp deltas, top1/max-tie changes, close-set changes, policy L1/KL with zero-support handling, root-WDL deltas and gated/stopped phase strata. No engine relabeling needed.
smallest_later_comparison.resolves: Prevalence/magnitude of observation drift and agreement of producing/consuming conventions.
smallest_later_comparison.not_resolved: Playing strength or100M recipe transfer. Material differences would motivate a separately designed matched-data training comparison with fixed recipe/value treatment and paired search evaluation; no GPU queue change is recommended here.
